scope: Native contextual PDF object and structure checks; a bounded development regression sample, not complete ISO validation.

corpus.selection: 64 files whose historical filename clause/test identify one of the eight object families in the pinned current XML. Candidate mappings remain provisional.

nativeTests.applicability_result: 22 object tests passed, zero failures; structure20 previously passed and checked again in final integrated suite.

criteria: Table4.39: Inline Intent is a real standard entry without abbreviation.
Table9.10: StructElem Type is optional; when present it must be StructElem.
Tables9.18–9.24: PDF1.4 standard structure types differ from later versions.
Table66 ICCBased Alternate may use a non-Pattern valid colour space with matching component count, so its colourant names require traversal.
Table132 with approved issues12/310/311: Type5 requires Default; components/default shall not be Type5. This check is separate from catalogue counts.
TransferFunction is not generally forbidden in PDF2; nonprimary components can require one.
Exact expressions and applicability of eight object families; no rule renumbering inferred from historical corpus filenames.

residuals: Filtered inline-image binary boundaries are not independently proved; valid filter/RI candidates can remain notVerified. Known invalid header values still fail.
ICC checks here establish indirect identity and structural facts only, not complete ICC colourimetry conformance.
The complete ISO32000 object/schema model and all custom extension semantics are not implemented.
PDF/A4 TransferFunction corpus cases cannot be mapped to HalftoneName: the pinned A4 XML omits the historical TransferFunction predicate; no general prohibition is invented.
Semantic correctness and complete assignment of logical structure, 3D binary payloads, and schema-dependent CMS/X.509 DER canonicality remain outside these object-family checks.
